measurement: activation_audit.json seriesUniverse: 196 MLB-associated series from GET /series, 92 with open markets, 6302 open MLB markets
principle: No MLB family is silently omitted. Depth goes where microstructure alpha is plausible; everything else still gets lightweight coverage so future signals remain discoverable.

FULL_MICROSTRUCTURE.capture: quotes + full order book + trade tape, every 10 minutes in the MLB window
FULL_MICROSTRUCTURE.why: per-game contracts that reprice continuously before first pitch -- the only place the Family C order-flow and reversal signals were found

LIGHT_CAPTURE.capture: quotes + per-run trade aggregates; order book only when the quote changed
LIGHT_CAPTURE.why: player props and per-game stat ladders: real research markets (and the reason issue #43 exists for their settlement), but too many tickers to justify per-ticker depth every 10 minutes

DAILY_ONLY.why: season-long futures, awards and leader boards move on news, not on pregame microstructure; a 10-minute cadence would be pure storage cost

series.reason: college baseball -- different sport universe; no MLB settlement or identity mapping exists in this repo

series.series: KXWBCGAME, KXWBCHIT, KXWBCHR, KXWBCKS, KXWBCRFI, KXWBCSPREAD, KXWBCTOTAL, KXMLBWORLD

Mexican Baseball League -- no schedule, identity or settlement source in this repo
Mobile Legends: Bang Bang esports; matched the MLB prefix scan by coincidence, not baseball at all

issue43Note: Pitcher and hitter prop settlement remains subject to issue #43; they stay in LIGHT_CAPTURE as research markets and remain in the alpha data map. Nothing here settles or wagers them.
